input.transcript:
[00:00] Customer: Hi, this is the billing lead at our company. I am calling about invoice FP-1042 for October. The total looks higher than last month and I want to go through it line by line.
[00:14] Support: Of course, let me pull it up. For the October cycle, the count is 1842300 billable events metered on your Growth plan.
[00:20] Customer: How many events do you have on record for us in October?
[00:23] Support: We have 1842300 events on record for October. That is the count the invoice is built on.
[00:26] Customer: And what did the usage come to before anything else?
[00:31] Support: Your metered usage came to $1,540. A platform credit of $300 was applied to this invoice, so the invoice total is $1,240.
[00:44] Customer: How much credit do we have left after that?
[00:49] Support: I can see the credit was applied, but I do not have the remaining credit balance in front of me on this screen. It is not stated on the invoice either.
[01:02] Customer: And overage, what are we paying beyond the included volume?
[01:08] Support: Overage beyond your included volume is billed at $0.40 per thousand events, and that rate is fixed for this cycle.
[01:19] Customer: One more thing. Does our plan include the advanced analytics entitlement? Our team wants to turn it on.
[01:27] Support: Advanced analytics is usually included on Growth, I believe. I would need to double-check your plan before I promise it.
[01:38] Customer: And the adjustment for the duplicate events from last week, when does that land?
[01:46] Support: The adjustment should show up probably in three to five business days.
[01:55] Customer: So what happens now?
[02:00] Support: I will escalate this to our billing team and call you back with the corrected invoice.
